objective: Standard statement: (1) decide every law on four bits that depends only on the base value and the number of ones among the other three corners, with weights in {-1, 0, 1} (global sign fixed), on the Sierpinski tetrahedra of levels 2 to 5, and the analogous five-bit laws on four-simplices of levels 2 and 3; group the exact ones by the symmetries and theorems of ticket A and record which supports are knots; (2) locate the angles theta in (0, pi) where the standing wave fails to be exact (zeros of lambda(theta)) on the gaskets of levels 2 to 4 in dimensions 2 and 3, by exact algebra in e^(i theta). Nearest known result: SIGNED-GASKETS-20261029-001B (the census in dimension 2). Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by SIMPLEX-GASKETS-20261029-001B-P001 (V1, proofs plus exact census): the cosine wave reproduces itself exactly when the number of simplices is odd and otherwise turns into the sine wave (so the d = 2 period-4 family is the cosine wave at pi/6); both waves fail at pi/4 exactly at even levels; parity is exact at powers of 2 in every dimension (odd parity only in even d). Census in d = 3 (levels 2-5) and d = 4 (levels 2-3): 75 and 75 exact laws, 13 and 8 knots, 6 and 2 sporadic; the knots exact at every computed level are exactly standing waves. Exceptional angles: rational only pi/2 and pi/4, the rest irrational.
title: Signed laws on Sierpinski tetrahedra and the exceptional angles
